title: 2.3 Common Ethiopian Animals and Plants
description: Endemic and common species found in Ethiopia including their habitats and characteristics

questions.question: Which of the following is an endemic mammal found only in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: The Walia ibex (Capra walie) is an endangered wild goat found only in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia.

questions.question: The Ethiopian wolf is also known as:
questions.explanation: The Ethiopian wolf (Canis simensis) is also called the Simien fox or Abyssinian wolf and is endemic to Ethiopia.

questions.question: Which primate is endemic to Ethiopia and lives in large social groups on grassy plateaus?
questions.explanation: The Gelada baboon (Theropithecus gelada) is an Old World monkey found only in the Ethiopian Highlands.

questions.question: Which endemic antelope species is found in the Bale Mountains of Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: The Mountain nyala (Tragelaphus buxtoni) is an endemic antelope species restricted to the Bale Mountains and nearby highlands.

questions.question: What is the scientific name of the Ethiopian wolf?
questions.explanation: Canis simensis is the scientific name of the Ethiopian wolf, one of Africa's most endangered carnivores.

questions.question: The Walia ibex is primarily found in which Ethiopian mountain range?
questions.explanation: The Walia ibex is restricted to the Simien Mountains National Park in northern Ethiopia.

questions.question: Which Ethiopian endemic bird is known for its striking blue and red plumage?
questions.explanation: The Ethiopian bush-crow (Zavattariornis stresemanni) is an endemic bird species found in southern Ethiopia.

questions.question: The Gelada baboon is unique among primates because it:
questions.explanation: The Gelada baboon is the only primate that is primarily graminivorous (grass-eating), feeding mostly on grass blades and seeds.

questions.question: Which Ethiopian plant is the original source of coffee?
questions.explanation: Coffea arabica originates from the highlands of Ethiopia and is the most widely consumed coffee species worldwide.

questions.question: Ensete, also known as false banana, is a staple food crop in which region of Ethiopia?
options: Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples' Region
questions.correctAnswer: Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples' Region
questions.explanation: Ensete (Ensete ventricosum) is a staple food crop mainly cultivated in southern Ethiopia.

questions.question: Which endemic Ethiopian plant produces the grain teff?
questions.explanation: Teff (Eragrostis tef) is an endemic Ethiopian cereal grain used to make injera, the national flatbread.

questions.question: What is the largest rodent found in Ethiopia and endemic to the region?
questions.explanation: The giant mole rat (Tachyoryctes macrocephalus) is an endemic rodent found in the Bale Mountains of Ethiopia.

questions.question: Which Ethiopian endemic bird is known for its unusual hopping behavior?
questions.explanation: The blue-winged goose (Cyanochen cyanoptera) is an endemic Ethiopian bird that walks with a distinctive hopping gait.

questions.question: The Ethiopian wolf primarily feeds on:
options: Rodents such as giant mole rats
questions.correctAnswer: Rodents such as giant mole rats
questions.explanation: The Ethiopian wolf's diet consists mainly of rodents, particularly the giant mole rat, which makes up over 90% of its diet.

questions.question: Lake Tana in Ethiopia is known for which group of endemic fish species?
questions.explanation: Lake Tana is home to a unique species flock of Labeobarbus barbs, with at least 15 endemic species found nowhere else.

questions.question: The Abyssinian longclaw is an endemic bird found mainly in:
questions.explanation: The Abyssinian longclaw (Macronyx flavicollis) is an endemic bird species found in the Ethiopian highlands.

questions.question: Which of these animals is NOT endemic to Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: The African leopard is found across sub-Saharan Africa, not just Ethiopia, whereas the others are Ethiopian endemics.

questions.question: What is the scientific name of the Walia ibex?
questions.explanation: Capra walie is the scientific name of the Walia ibex, an endangered goat species endemic to Ethiopia's Simien Mountains.

questions.question: The Bale monkey is endemic to which part of Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: The Bale monkey (Chlorocebus djamdjamensis) is a primate species endemic to the Bale Mountains region.

questions.question: Which of the following is an endemic Ethiopian plant used as a stimulant?
questions.explanation: Khat (Catha edulis) is an endemic plant whose leaves are chewed for their stimulant effect, though coffee is also indigenous.

questions.question: The Ethiopian Highlands are home to which unique vegetation zone?
questions.explanation: The Ethiopian Highlands feature an Afroalpine zone above 3,200 meters with unique plants like giant lobelia and everlasting flowers.

questions.question: Nechisar National Park in Ethiopia is famous for which endemic animal?
questions.explanation: Nechisar National Park is the only known location of the Nechisar nightjar (Caprimulgus solala), an endemic bird species.

questions.question: Ethiopia is considered the origin of which important crop plant?
questions.explanation: Ethiopia is the birthplace of Coffea arabica, with wild coffee forests still found in the southwestern highlands.

questions.question: The Ethiopian wolf is classified as which conservation status?
questions.explanation: The Ethiopian wolf is listed as Endangered by the IUCN, with fewer than 500 adults remaining in the wild.

questions.question: Which of the following is an endemic Ethiopian bird with the scientific name Zavattariornis stresemanni?
questions.explanation: Zavattariornis stresemanni is the Ethiopian bush-crow, an endemic bird found only in southern Ethiopia.
